name: Neat Double
description: Cast a double so neat in every small habit that an opponent cannot say which figure is the user.

name: Drawn Shade
description: Draw a shade across the line of a soul-strike so that the strike turns after it and misses the user.

name: Quick Silhouette
description: Throw a silhouette to the chosen spot and slip into it in the time of one breath.

name: Sharp Echo
description: Cut the echo hard across an opponent's soul so that the touch stings like a thin blade.

name: Layered Likeness
description: Stack several likenesses one behind another so that a soul-strike must break each in turn before it reaches the user.

name: Echo Pursuit
description: Chase a retreating opponent with an echo that strikes the soul from several sides at once.

name: Perfect Counterpart
description: Raise a counterpart so exact that it fights as the user fights and draws every hostile soul-sense to itself.

name: Counterpart Break
description: Burst the counterpart inside an opponent's guard so that all the soul force it held drives into the opponent at once.

name: Husk Sentinel
description: Stand a hollow figure in front of the user to catch a soul-strike on its empty chest.

name: Procession Shade
description: Walk a shade slowly past an opponent so that the opponent's soul-sense turns to follow it.

name: Hushed Courier
description: Send a hushed courier ahead and arrive where it stops with no sound and no pull on the soul-field.

name: Spiteful Echo
description: Snap a spiteful echo against an opponent's soul so that a sour jolt of force follows the touch.

name: Chorus Shield
description: Line the hollow figures shoulder to shoulder in a wall that stands against a wide sweep of soul force.

name: Rousing Echo
description: Lend an ally the steadiness of a cast echo so that the ally's own soul-technique holds firm for a few breaths.

name: Marching Host
description: Fill the field with a host of hollow figures that march at the user's word and hide the true body among them.

name: Host Collapse
description: Collapse the whole host at once so that every figure releases its soul force into the opponents nearest to it.

name: Azure Twin
description: Cast a twin tinted pale blue and set it at the user's side so that an opponent splits attention between the two.

name: Skylit Image
description: Hold a skylit image up to a soul-bolt so that the bolt bends away along its bright edge.

name: Lucid Stride
description: Take a clear even pace behind a cast twin and come out of it where the twin was meant to stand.

name: Feather Likeness
description: Brush a feather-light likeness over an opponent's soul and leave a sudden sting where it passes.

name: Paired Cloak
description: Draw the twin round the user like a veil that takes the first and second soul-strikes of an exchange.

name: Skyward Double
description: Lift the double high so that the opponent looks up while the user steps in low.

name: Bright Pair
description: Strike with the user and the twin from two sides so that two bright lines of soul force close on the opponent.

name: Twinned Aegis
description: Bind the twin and the user into one standing ward that turns aside the weight of a heavy soul-strike.

name: Twin Judgment
description: Bring both twins down on one opponent in a single stroke that lands like a sentence handed down.

name: High Shade
description: Loft a high shade above the user to read the souls spread out below it.

name: Lofted Image
description: Hold a lofted image above an opponent's head so that the opponent looks up and loses the true body.

name: Lifting Step
description: Climb a short rise of soul force laid down by the shade and step off it a stride further on.

name: Gentle Phantom
description: Let a gentle phantom drift over the user as a soft ward against a thin soul-lash.

name: Soaring Double
description: Send the double soaring away on one line while the user leaves on another.

name: Windless Echo
description: Hold a windless echo high and still so that every soul that moves below it shows as a ripple.

name: Lofted Veil
description: Drop a veil from the lofted shade over the user so that a downward soul-strike slides off its folds.

name: Skyborne Revenant
description: Gather the lofted shade into a revenant that falls on one opponent from above with the full weight of the cast.

name: Shade Ascendant
description: Hold the user's awareness in the shade as it rises and move the body to wherever the shade sees clearest.

name: Gale Echo
description: Throw an echo on a fast gust of soul force so that it hits before the opponent sees it move.

name: Gusting Double
description: Whirl the double in short gusts round the user so that the true body is hard to follow.

name: Leaning Shade
description: Lean the shade into a soul-bolt so that the bolt rolls along it and away from the user.

name: Fleet Likeness
description: Let a fleet likeness run ahead and pull the user after it in a swift low dash.

name: Whistling Image
description: Send a whistling image out and read from its note where the nearest souls stand.

name: Gust Drapery
description: Spin a veil of phantoms round the user so that soul-strikes glance off the moving figures.

name: Fleeing Effigy
description: Drive an effigy to flee in plain view while the user slips away unmarked in the other direction.

name: Cutting Surge
description: Loose a surge of phantoms that cuts through an opponent's soul-guard from the side.

name: Gale Wraith
description: Raise a wraith in the gale and scatter it at the moment of contact so that its soul force sweeps every opponent in front of it.

name: Waiting Wraith
description: Plant a wraith in the soul-field of a spot and let it spring on the first hostile soul that crosses it.

name: Sworn Echo
description: Speak a short vow and let the echo answer it so that the answer seems to come from the wrong place.

name: Bare Wraith
description: Hold a plain wraith between the user and a soul-strike as a barrier of bare presence.

name: Swift Vow
description: Bind the step to a swift vow and let the wraith carry the body to the marked spot.

name: Pledge Murmur
description: Whisper to the wraith and hear back which near soul bears ill will.

name: Owed Word
description: Send the wraith to strike the soul of one who has broken a word given to the user.

name: Pledge Shade
description: Pledge the shade to an ally's side where it takes a soul-strike meant for that ally.

name: Gale Pledge
description: Ride a gust of the pledge to the opponent and strike the soul on arrival.

name: Cleared Oath
description: Wash a false oath or a forced vow out of an ally's soul with a clean wraith.

name: Anchoring Wraith
description: Hold the soul of an ally who has just collapsed in a wraith's grasp so that it stays in the body for the short span in which breath can be restored.

name: Sworn Wraithstorm
description: Loose a storm of bound wraiths that bears down on an opponent's soul and presses the opponent's techniques lower.
